name: ZenMode
description: Hosted MCP server for ZenMode LinkedIn outreach. Reads campaigns, contacts and conversation history on the signed-in account, and can add or remove leads, pause or exclude a contact, and change campaign targeting. A connection is read only unless the user chooses Read and change, and there is no tool that sends a LinkedIn message or connection request. Sign in with OAuth, or use a ZenMode API key as a Bearer token. Requires a ZenMode plan (Practitioner and above).
author: ZenMode
